newsitem.title: CHINA: Tricom forms south China joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Tricom forms south China joint venture.

text.p: Tricom Holdings Ltd said on Friday it had opened a joint venture with a subsidiary of China's Ministry of Post and Telecommunications (MPT) to provide telecommunications equipment and services in southern China.
The venture, Guangdong Tricom Telecommunications Co Ltd, was formed by Tricom and the MPT's Guang Dong Hong Lian Information Co Ltd (GDHL) with an initial investment of HK$45 million.

In addition to acting as Tricom's southern China regional headquarters for marketing and sales of telecom products and technical support, the venture will provide systems integration services and offer video conferencing facilities.
Tricom chairman Samuel Sung said the new joint venture was the company's sixth in China. Tricom also has 17 branches on the mainland and more than 600 staff.

While a seventh joint venture to develop telecom software was under negotiation with a subsidiary of China's military, the company expected to pause in its expansion and spend time consolidating and developing its current operations, Sung said.
Tricom is controlled by China Strategic Holdings Ltd.
